svg.aria-label: Microarchitecture block diagram of version 2: APB decode, the channel block holding per-channel registers, a read engine with a round-robin arbiter, a two-entry FIFO, a write engine, and the IRQ register, with numbered design decisions
svg.text: One owner per register: the channel block owns every per-channel register; the engines only report.
the only writer of channel state
1 a FIFO lets a read overlap a write: the 4.5-cycle target
2 round robin: two channels, neither starves
3 abort stops reads, drop discards queued words: precise errors
